newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Cockerill buys rest of Monopanel.
newsitem.headline: Cockerill buys rest of Monopanel.

text.p: Belgian steel firm Cockerill Sambre said in a statement it had bought the remaining 50 percent of shares it did not own in French company Monopanel from Groupe Metecno International BV.
It gave no financial details of the deal.
Cockerill, which acquired the shares through its French unit Haironville SA, already owned fifty percent of Monopanel.

Situated in Chauny, Monopanel is a leading French manufacturer of panels and is active on the French and Benelux markets, Cockerill said in a statement. It had a 1995 turnover of 352 million French francs and employs 217 people.
The Belgian steel group said its acquisition was made on December 20, and that it reinforced Cockerill's building division on the French market.
